02 / Actual Aurum output

One river, three times of day

These 854 × 480 in-game screenshots use the same camera and world, with the HUD hidden and daylight cycle frozen. The controls change only the time of day. The test config was LOW with parallax relief disabled and vanilla textures: these images do not demonstrate 3D voxel depth. Click the image to open the original screenshot.

River opposite a village · facing west

Noon: cool blue overhead sky, distinct tree faces, a visible riverbed and restrained reflections.

Visual read. The river retains the colour and texture of its bed near shore. The same tree and hillside gain warmer exposed faces at sunset while their shaded sides stay darker. At night, the river has local-light reflections without a false sun-glitter path. This is a rendering smoke test, not a matched 0.5.4 comparison or a claim of visual parity with Photon.
03 / Implementation

Changes in 0.5.5

The edits stay in Aurum's existing LUT, terrain and water paths. They avoid an extra full-screen pass.

01 / SKY

Less fixed pastel grading

Golden-hour colour now follows the sun direction more closely. Daylight LUT desaturation and lift are reduced, preserving the blue-to-amber gradient.

02 / FOLIAGE

More directional tree shade

Leaf faces receive less uniform light, so lit crowns and shaded interiors carry different values while retaining their natural colour.

03 / WATER

Clearer, calmer reflection

Lower absorption reveals more shallow riverbed. Sun caustics respect shadowing and stop at night; glints are broader and bounded to preserve reflected colour.

04 / SHARPNESS

Close terrain detail

A modest near-camera mip bias applies to solid terrain, and displaced normal/material samples keep more local detail. Foliage remains filtered to limit shimmer.

05 / VOXEL DEPTH

Relief with shaded sidewalls

The existing pixel-voxel parallax gains subtle cavity shading on deeper exposed sidewalls, strengthening depth without adding more ray steps.

06 / SCOPE

The next structural gap

Water still reflects atmosphere and nearby terrain without clouds. Photon also uses a richer scattering and reflection pipeline; those remain separate measured work.

04 / Validation

What was verified

BuildGradle build passed; packaged JAR passes ZIP integrity check and contains the updated Fabric mod.
Shader syntaxExpanded terrain fragment shader passed glslangValidator; the Minecraft client compiled 14 Aurum shader programs.
AtmosphereSky LUT harness produced finite, nonnegative results at noon, sunset, rainy sunset and night.
ClientLaunched with software OpenGL, entered a world, and visually checked the same river at noon, sunset and night.
Performance limitNo UHD 620 measurement is available from this cloud machine. Low and High F8 timings and moving-camera shimmer checks remain for target hardware.

The test sheet specifies same-scene 0.5.4 comparisons, movement checks, and hardware timings. Authentication and audio service errors in the cloud session did not block single-player rendering.

05 / Delivery

Aurum 0.5.5 · Minecraft 1.20.1

Put the JAR in the Fabric mods folder with Fabric API and Sodium 0.5.8–0.5.x. Java 17 or newer is required. Source and report live on the codex branch.
